transformScale.rule: ButtonManager applies screenWidthAdjustRate and normalizedNoteSize*ScreenToSafeAreaRatio to every child ParticleSystem own Transform.localScale. The combined g is therefore present on each ParticleSystem in the hierarchy.
transformScale.nestedPositionVelocityRule: 103 enabled child renderers compose emitting-system g and root-ParticleSystem g (g squared) for local emission position and velocity; the enabled root swipe renderer consumes one g.
transformScale.localBillboardSizeRule: All systems use ParticleSystemScalingMode.Local, so billboard size consumes only the emitting system own g while parent rotations still orient Local-aligned geometry.

colorPipeline.browser_blending: straight-alpha source with material SrcAlpha/OneMinusSrcAlpha or SrcAlpha/One in linear target
colorPipeline.browser_output: unpremultiply-linear, linear-to-sRGB encode, repremultiply for final canvas composition

rendererGeometry.signed_height: height*lengthScale+speed*velocityScale; abs extent plus independent long-axis/UV sign

Keep particle color as Float32 Linear shader input; quantizing sample RGB to an RGB8 Sprite tint before blending is prohibited.
Use exact renderer alignment, render mode, material, UV, max-size, sorting and GamePlayButton anchor.
Portable deterministic random and module draw assignment remain explicitly distinct from fixed-device native random; no portable raster may be claimed as an original package frame.

lane.requirement: Consume the exact per-slot sprite sequence, right-side flip, VisibleOutsideMask composition, bottom pivot, Animator channels and renderer disable. Name-only or four-PNG-only validation is insufficient.

gameClear.lifecycle: Natural BGM end enters GameClearAnimStart (11), plays the base clear graph plus the clear-status additional graph, waits for RhythmGameClearAnimController.ClearAnimationFinished, enters GameClearAnimEnd (12), and only then begins onExit.
requirements: Every clear status plays the base MusicGameClear graph; status 2 adds FullCombo_text_in and status 3 adds AllPerfect_text_in.

Both additional roots own UIPanel alpha 1, clipping None, depth 20 and sortingOrder 100; the serialized clipRange/softness values are inert while clipping is None and must not be turned into a synthetic crop.
Additional branches preserve their 17/22 UITexture graphs, six/twelve ParticleSystems, active/color/transform channels and parent hierarchy.
Hold the full 3.233-second base presentation endpoint, then the independent 15ms onExit edge.
Do not replace branch particles with path-hash random states claimed as native exact; preserve the portable difference boundary.
